cc:Work.dc:title: Equip Triage: order-fault model comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Aligned detection, false-alarm and CPU-throughput plots for 192 synthetic pairs. Milestone-filtered custom and BERT-Mini models tie with learned precedence.
